customManagers.description: Pin for the data/postgres module in ok-karthik/enterprise-aws-infrastructure. That repo tags every module separately (<module>-vX.Y.Z), and the github-tags datasource returns EVERY tag in it, so this manager only accepts tags with its own prefix; anything else (eks-v1.2.0, vpc-v1.0.0) is invalid under this versioning and ignored.
